answer 1. I freed Sesk, who drew sap for the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, an Argonian woman who moves about. Jars come to this camp then go to her; the sap goes into a draught for something to do with "the Eye". The grey paste is called the seal. 2. Go back to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her. 3. I could go straight to Vosh-Leera, or first ask Sesk more questions, or look for Cuts-the-Old-Knot myself, which seems dangerous. 4. I do not know what the Eye is, what is in the seal, or where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is. Vosh-Leera or Weeltul may know.

answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka through Vosh-Leera. The Unbound drain Hist trees for sap for a draught tied to "the Eye", then seal the scars. Vosh-Leera says it is beyond her and paid me 100 gold. 2. Go to Weeltul at the Hist pool in Jal-Veesa, pay 25 gold, and ride the rootworm to Helstrom to find Nesh-Deeka, the order handler. 3. Take the rootworm as told, or travel another way, though the land is deadly. I could also prepare first. 4. I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, or exactly where Nesh-Deeka lives beyond her named door. Weeltul and the Helstrom root-tender can guide me.

answer 1. The Unbound, led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain Hist sap for a draught tied to "the Eye" and seal the scars. Vosh-Leera sent me on to the handler Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 2. answer I am Tarin, a thief working for the Toh-Reel-Ka via Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa. At Karsh-Naal Camp I picked the novice lock on Sesk's Cage and freed Sesk. She said the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot (an Argonian woman who moves about), drain Hist trees. Jars go via the camp to her, and the sap goes into a draught for something to do with "the Eye". The grey paste in the scars is called the seal, and its contents are unknown. Vosh-Leera paid me 100 gold and sent me to the order handler Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, far south. Weeltul at Jal-Veesa's Hist pool will call the rootworm for 25 gold, and it surfaces in Helstrom's city tree pool. The root-tender there can point to Nesh-Deeka's House. I have about 150 gold, 2 lockpicks, the Note to the Sap-Takers, Cure Poison potions and the Hist blessing. Unknown: what the Eye is, what the seal is, where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is, and whether the Teel-Fen tree lives.
